+# 고정 146개 현실성 보충 감사 — root controller
+
+실제 전체 원장의 현실성 미완료142개(17 NOT_ASSESSED/97 EDITORIAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED/28 HOLD)와 별도 고정4 RW 법규 재감사를 ID와 원 report raw/row SHA, 현재 객체 hash 및 style SHA로 고정합니다. 이전 archive-only 부분진단95는 전체 현실성 census가 아니었습니다. 기존 raw 자료는 보존하며 이 정정을 별도 증거에 기록합니다. 4 RW는 이미 nonlegacy safety hold로 안내돼 있었으므로 알려진 negative 안내 누락으로 세지 않습니다.
+
+이 경로는 기존 fixed2/38 handler와 native engine을 확장하지 않습니다. `review_queue`의 unchanged independent-legacy lease/token/submit/ordered integration을 별도 wrapper/state에서 사용합니다. 실제 별도 fresh actor/session은 `/root/realism95_a`부터 `_d`, auditor_instance는 `GPT:<actor>:20261104`입니다. 실제 세션 생성 전에는 claim하지 않습니다. 배정은40/40/40/26이며 동일 세션을 여러 instance로 세지 않습니다.
+
+Root만 다음 변경 작업을 실행합니다. 공통 인수는 `python scripts/realism_completion_review.py --root <controller-root> --controller-actor /root ...`입니다.
+
+1. `plan`: `reports/full-corpus-review/realism-completion-v1/`의 work-queue.json/controller-scope.json/nearest-visible-input.json을 만듭니다. 기존 증거 덮어쓰기 없이 같은 plan은 idempotent합니다. root가 커밋합니다. 실제 리뷰는0개입니다.
+2. 실제 fresh 세션 생성 후 `claim --actor <actual-actor> --session-id <same-actor> --auditor-instance <stable-instance> --actual-fresh-session-created --output <scratch-assignment>`을 실행하고 queue를 커밋합니다. Assignment는 old report/verdict/actor/exposure 이유를 포함하지 않습니다. 모델에 controller scope를 전달하지 않습니다.
+3. `prepare-worker --job <id> --token <token> --destination <isolated-worktree>`는 assignment.base_commit에서 지정 branch를 만듭니다. claim 후의 queue commit을 worker diff에 섞지 않습니다. 같은 branch의 destination은 재사용합니다. Worker checkout은 정책4개·current style·worker contract·own output prefix로 제한하며 controller scope/원장/이전 보고서/hidden 질문 원본은 checkout하지 않습니다. Worker는 원본/공유 state를 수정하지 않습니다.
+4. Read-only `export-input --assignment <scratch-assignment> --output <scratch-visible-packet>`은 --controller-actor 없이 실행할 수 있습니다. 모델에 이 packet과 별도 WORKER_CONTRACT, 정책, current style만 제공합니다. 프로그램은 내부적으로 controller hash를 읽되 이전 결론은 출력하지 않습니다.
+5. Worker는 자기 prefix의 report/own memo/metadata만 commit합니다. 고정4 법규 근거만 추가로 허용합니다. Scratch result manifest와 exact40 worker SHA로 read-only `validate-worker --job ... --result ...`를 실행합니다. Worker commit은 실제 branch tip이어야 하고 base 이후 변경 파일 집합은 참조된 own-prefix 근거와 정확히 같아야 합니다.
+6. Root가 순서대로 worker commit을 가져와 cherry-pick하고, exact result bytes를 own-prefix result.json에 둡니다. `submit --job --token --result <same-manifest>` 후 queue/result를 커밋합니다. root만 `integrate --job`하고 queue를 다시 커밋합니다. 원 commit/현재 HEAD의 모든 report/memo/meta/공식 source bytes를 비교합니다. CI의 얕은 clone consumer는 실제 통합 receipt를 재검증하며 옛 worker Git object를 요구하지 않습니다.
+7. 실제 fresh FAIL만 source-bound archive warning으로 안내합니다. 고정4의 이전 nonlegacy hold는 그대로 유지하며 새 결과를 별도 history/next evidence로 연결합니다. HOLD28이나 기존 fixed2의 FAIL은 fresh PASS로 override하지 않습니다. 두 fixed2 ID의 기존 negative source도 controller scope에 고정합니다. Queue/근거 삭제·변조·stale content/style/누락·중복은 fail closed입니다.
+8. `heartbeat --job --token`은 실제 lease를 연장합니다. 실제 worker 소실 시 `revoke --job --token --reason`은 append-only 기존 revoke를 사용합니다. 소급 시각/old actor 사칭 없이 새 attempt/token으로 다시 배정합니다. 동일 submit/integrate는 idempotent하며 결과가 다른 재제출은 거부합니다.
+
+원 primary report/grade/key, author·법규 negative, 질문 본문/사용자 기록/default 선택은 바뀌지 않습니다. 새 source grade와 proof를 별도로 추가합니다. Raw primary PASS를 보존하고 effective PASS는 기존 PASS와 유효한 신규 PASS의 unique union입니다. 기존 realism HOLD/FAIL을 덮어쓰거나 이미 집계한 보충 PASS를 다시 세지 않습니다. 고정4 외 법규/key credit은0, 전체146의 새 원문-read/author/canonical RELEASED credit은0입니다. 고정4도 실제 current-hash 독립 key 판정만 최대4개 합집합에 추가합니다. Native 통합 전에는 pending이며 report 파일 존재만으로 진척을 올리지 않습니다.
+
+후속 dispatch/cache 보완: 공개15 보호 절차는 기존 법규 필수 guard에 실제 법규 기록만 전달합니다. Legal-free source는 명시적 REALISM_COMPLETION 타입과 현재 hash/native source를 엄격 consumer로 다시 검증하고 전146 default 제외 및 실제 negative 안내를 별도로 확인합니다. Static3와 native parent inventory는 committed bytes로 병합하고 중복은 동등해야 합니다. 보호 함수의 이 typed dispatch 변경은 후속 증거에 명시하며 이전 AST 동일 주장을 현재 코드에 재사용하지 않습니다.
+
+캐시는 이미 커밋된 `reports/full-corpus-review/final26-evidence/sources/nabpformat.meta.json`의 정확 SHA636934be58e2fd6567b355d40a76d7748d51b005674aa7903da480ceb847a665를 scope에 승인 결박합니다. Worker packet에 제공하는 것은 이 source-only 원 metadata뿐이며 prior question verdict는 포함하지 않습니다. Worker는 자기 prefix에 원 metadata를 정확히 복사하고, 새 own metadata/memo에는 실제 claim 후 재독 시각과 SAME_DAY_RETAINED_CACHE를 기록합니다. 원200/조회시각/raw/text SHA는 변경할 수 없고, origin raw는 public에 보존하지 않습니다. Worker commit의 허용 파일 집합에는 이 정확 origin metadata 한 파일만 추가됩니다. 다른 임의 파일 허용은 없습니다.
+
+실제 완료된 completion의 NOT_ASSESSED/HOLD는 FAIL로 바꾸지 않습니다. INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_FINDING에 이 보류 source를 연결할 때에는 exact completion purpose, 실제 INTEGRATED native receipt/current hash/full readscope, decision:HOLD 및 명시적 blocker를 엄격 consumer로 다시 검증합니다. 경고 reason에는 해당 blocker를 그대로 포함하고 checked_at/report SHA도 일치해야 합니다. 일반 pending·다른 purpose·미통합 보고서의 NOT_ASSESSED는 허용하지 않습니다. 기존 HOLD 안내는 그대로 유지할 수 있으며, 새 blocked report를 안내 source/history로 채택하면 채택한 해당 blocked row의 정확 source-bound 안내가 필요합니다. 이는 새 결함 발견이나 법규 grade 변경을 뜻하지 않습니다. 기존 MA-CASE-0028/0029/0030의 원 HOLD/AMBIGUOUS/HOLD는 그대로이며, 새 판정은 기존 불명확성 재확인입니다.

+# Fresh reviewer 입력·제출 계약
+
+이 문서는 reviewer 전용이며 기존 판정이나 기대 정답을 제공하지 않습니다. Controller scope, 이전 보고서, 원장, notice, 다른 reviewer 결론 및 숨은 author truth를 모델로 읽지 않습니다. 검증 프로그램이 이 자료를 내부적으로 읽어 hash를 대조할 수 있지만 내용을 출력해서는 안 됩니다. 독립성은 실제 새 세션 provenance와 root의 실제 배정에 기반하며 문자열이나 검증 PASS가 인증하지 않습니다.
+
+입력은 root가 제공한 blinded assignment, visible packet, 네 기본 정책, 현재 style profile입니다. Visible packet의 원 stem·모든 영어 보기·저장 key·보이는 한국어 core/모든 choice rationale/learning boundary를 전부 읽습니다. 수정하지 않습니다. `nearest_visible`은 canonical439/public2349 전체에서 stem token cosine으로 찾은 각 pool의 상위3 후보입니다. 점수는 후보 탐색일 뿐 판정이 아닙니다. 가까운 후보6개의 stem과 모든 보기 원문을 실제로 읽고 구체적으로 비교합니다. 자신이 배정받은 원문과 비교한 실제 사실을 한국어로 기록합니다.
+
+10개 기준은 `jurisprudence_reasoning`, `practice_plausibility`, `authentic_distractors`, `wording_not_guessable`, `reasoning_not_trivia`, `natural_rule_combination`, `appropriate_drug_context`, `distinct_from_bank`, `not_schedule_flashcard`, `public_style_without_copying`입니다. 각 기준은 true/false/null과 개별 한국어 이유를 가집니다. PASS/KEEP는 전부 true이고 실제 공개 형식 확인 및 비교를 완료했을 때만 가능합니다. 실제 결함은 FAIL과 MINOR_EDIT/MAJOR_REWRITE/HOLD/DELETE, 확인하지 못한 기준은 NOT_ASSESSED 또는 HOLD와 명시적 blocker로 남깁니다. 보호된 시험·회상·상용 문항은 열거나 사용하지 않습니다.
+
+`https://nabp.pharmacy/programs/examinations/mpje/take-the-mpje-exam/`의 공개 형식을 직접 확인하고 자신의 추상 memo만 public report에 보존합니다. 원 raw와 추출 text는 public commit하지 않습니다. Metadata는 official_url/final_url, 실제 status, retrieved_at/read_at(UTC aware), 원 raw_sha256/text_sha256, raw_path:null, text_path:null, retention:`PRIVATE_NOT_REDISTRIBUTED`, 실제 대상 형식을 읽었으면 document_identity_status:`OFFICIAL_FORMAT_TARGET_DIRECTLY_READ`를 기록합니다. Memo는 own_abstract_memo_ko, source_is_format_only:true, protected_material_not_used:true, reviewed_at을 기록합니다. 공개 형식은 법률권위가 아닙니다. 조회 실패는 실제 status/한계를 정직하게 기록하고 PASS로 만들지 않습니다.
+
+보고서는 assignment의 `output_prefix` 아래 `report.json`, `format-memo.json`, `format-meta.json`만 작성합니다. `legal_retry_question_hashes`에 명시된 ID가 있을 때만 해당 ID의 별도 법규 재감사를 실제 수행하고 공식 government raw/text/meta를 같은 prefix에 추가합니다. 다른 ID에 법규 판정 필드를 넣지 않습니다. 보고서/근거 외 원본·공유 queue·generated 파일·visible 입력 packet을 worker commit에 넣지 않습니다.
+
+Top-level 필수 필드:
+
+```
+purpose: assignment.purpose
+stage: independent-legacy
+independent_of_authors: true
+auditor: GPT
+auditor_instance: assignment.auditor_instance
+actor_provenance: assignment.actor_provenance
+native_assignment_binding: assignment의 job_id/sequence/question_hashes/stage/worker/worker_branch/attempt 정확7필드
+scope_raw_sha256: assignment.scope_binding.raw_sha256
+question_hashes: assignment.question_hashes
+style_profile: assignment.style_profile
+canonical_audit: false
+canonical_release_credit: 0
+legal_audit_credit: 0
+key_assessment_credit: 0
+new_original_read_credit: 0
+release_eligible: false
+fresh_session_fork_turns: none
+prior_conclusions_read: false
+hidden_truth_read: false
+reviewed_at: 실제 YYYY-MM-DD
+completed_at: 실제 aware timestamp
+public_format_evidence: memo_path/memo_sha256/metadata_path/metadata_sha256
+records: 모든 배정 ID 각각1행
+```
+
+각 row는 question_id, record_sha256, visible_content_sha256(packet의 값), release_eligible:false, read_scope, realism_review를 가집니다. read_scope는 original_stem/stored_key_read/complete_core_reasoning_read/learning_boundary_read:true, all_choices_read/all_choice_explanations_read:실제 보기 ID 순서 전체, prior_question_author_or_independent_verdicts_read/hidden_statement_truth_read:false입니다.
+
+realism_review에는 verdict, decision, criteria10개, criterion_findings_ko10개, finding_ko, 제한 시 blocker, duplicate_evidence를 기록합니다. duplicate_evidence에는 canonical_pool_count:439, public_pool_count:2349, pool_visible_sha256:packet 값, canonical/public 각각 후보3행(question_id, visible_sha256, stem_and_all_choices_read:true, 실제 comparison_ko)이 필요합니다. NOT_ASSESSED/HOLD도 시도한 비교와 확인 한계를 개별 이유에 기록합니다. 읽지 않은 후보에 true를 쓰지 않습니다. 후보 원문에 접근할 수 없으면 controller에 입력 장애를 알리고 완료했다고 제출하지 않습니다.
+
+법규 재감사 ID에만 legal_review를 기록합니다. actual stored_key/independently_expected_key, question_type, CORRECT/INCORRECT polarity, verdict/기존 key의 YES/NO/AMBIGUOUS/NOT_ASSESSED, finding_ko, prior_conclusions_read/hidden_truth_read:false, 원 core/모든 rationale/learning boundary 실독 판정이 필요합니다. 모든 선택지는 choice_id, 정확 option_text_sha256, proposition_supported(bool/null), 한국어 finding, authority_refs를 가집니다. Authorities는 source_id, official government HTTPS URL, exact_section, law_checked_date, effective_date_or_version_basis(별도 효력일 미확정은 명시), raw/text/metadata path와 SHA를 결박합니다. Metadata는 official_url, raw_path/raw_sha256, text_path/text_sha256, status:200, method, 실제 retrieved_at/read_at, document_identity_status:`OFFICIAL_TARGET_PROVISIONS_DIRECTLY_READ`를 가집니다. 자료나 독립성 한계가 있으면 HOLD/NOT_ASSESSED와 빈 expected key를 유지합니다. 공식 문서를 실제로 대조하지 않은 key는 YES/NO로 판정하지 않습니다.
+
+Worker commit 후 scratch의 result envelope는 stage/provenance/zero-credit/release_eligible 필드, question_hashes, worker_commit(정확40SHA), result_path:`output_prefix/result.json`, results:[question_id, disposition, evidence_path:`output_prefix/report.json`, evidence_sha256]입니다. Result 파일은 worker commit에 넣지 않습니다. Read-only post-commit 검증은 controller repository를 --root로 지정하고 `python <controller-root>/scripts/realism_completion_review.py --root <controller-root> validate-worker --job <job-id> --result <scratch-result.json>`으로 실행합니다. 이는 보고서 계약 검증이며 현실성 PASS/법규 PASS를 만들어 내지 않습니다. 실제 원문 실독·조회·개별 판정은 reviewer가 수행합니다.
+
+당일 보존 캐시를 사용하는 경우 `public_format_cache_origin`의 승인 원 metadata를 자기 prefix의 `format-origin-meta.json`에 **원 바이트 그대로** 복사합니다. 승인 SHA는 `636934be58e2fd6567b355d40a76d7748d51b005674aa7903da480ceb847a665`입니다. 이는 원 2026-11-04T18:19:26.088117+00:00 조회 metadata이며 새 GET이 아닙니다. `public_format_evidence`에 origin_metadata_path/origin_metadata_sha256를 추가합니다. 자기 format-meta는 retrieval_mode:`SAME_DAY_RETAINED_CACHE`와 원 retrieved_at/official_url/final_url/status200/raw_sha256/text_sha256를 동일하게 보존하고, 실제 배정 이후 원문을 재독한 read_at을 기록합니다. own memo의 reviewed_at도 실제 배정 후 재독 시각입니다. 원 raw/text는 private 유지하며 원 metadata에 없던 raw_path/text_path 필드를 원본에 추가하지 않습니다. 자기 새 metadata의 raw_path/text_path는 null입니다. 재독은 원조회와 같은 실제 날짜이며 completed_at 이전이어야 합니다. 새 GET이면 retrieval_mode:`LIVE`로 두고 실제 GET 시각도 claim 이후여야 합니다. 실패한 최신 GET을 200으로 표시하거나 원 시각을 변경하지 않습니다.
+
+고정 법규 재감사 네 문항은 현재 모두 SBA입니다. YES/NO 판정은 각 보기의 proposition_supported가 전부 bool이어야 하며, 실제 질문 lead의 CORRECT/INCORRECT 극성에 따라 true/false 집합이 independently_expected_key의 정확한 단일 보기와 일치해야 합니다. KEEP는 YES만 가능하며, AMBIGUOUS/NOT_ASSESSED는 명시적 HOLD와 blocker가 필요합니다. 다른 원 key를 미리 상속하거나 null truth로 YES를 인증하지 않습니다.

+# 절차적 미판정 9문항의 실제 fresh 법규 재감사
+

+

+# 공개15 typed dispatch·당일 캐시·고정4 정답 일관성 보완
+
+이 증거는 초기 후보78d34b82의 후속 수정입니다. 초기 후보의 notes_published15_closure 바이트/AST 동일 주장은 이 후속 후보에 적용하지 않습니다. 실제 코드 검토에서 다음 경로 문제를 확인해 수정했습니다.
+
+- P1: source binding에 들어온 legal-free 현실성 row를 기존 법규 필수 safety guard가 읽으면 legal_review KeyError가 발생했습니다. 공개15 default safety 함수만 명시적 typed dispatch를 추가했습니다. 실제 법규 row는 기존 guard로 전달하고, REALISM_COMPLETION 전용 row는 정확 native report/source/current hash 재검증, 전146 default 제외, 실제 negative source warning 검사를 거칩니다. dummy 법규 판정은 만들지 않습니다.
+- P1: 공개15 archive caller는 native primary만 전달했지만146 중에는 원 static wave2 row도 있습니다. 신규 consumer만 정확한 원 static3와 native 입력을 committed bytes로 병합하고 모든 overlap의 row 동등성을 검사합니다. Static3 raw SHA도 scope에 고정합니다. PENDING부터 누락·변조는 fail closed이며 KeyError로 처리하지 않습니다. 기존 세 fixed consumer의 인수/범위는 그대로입니다.
+- 당일 캐시: LIVE GET은 기존처럼 claim 이후 실제 조회여야 합니다. SAME_DAY_RETAINED_CACHE는 승인된 원 metadata를 worker의 format-origin-meta.json에 원 바이트 그대로 복사해야 합니다. 승인 원본은 final26-evidence/sources/nabpformat.meta.json, SHA636934be58e2fd6567b355d40a76d7748d51b005674aa7903da480ceb847a665, 실제 원 조회2026-11-04T18:19:26.088117+00:00입니다. 원 URL/status200/조회시각/raw/text SHA와 worker 새 metadata가 일치하며, actual claim 후 read_at/own memo reviewed_at부터 completed_at까지 chronology를 검증합니다. 원본에 없던 raw_path/text_path를 원 metadata에 추가하지 않습니다. 저작권 raw/text는 public 미보존이며 이 검증은 retained own memo와 exact 원 metadata를 검증합니다. 원 payload의 실제 private 실독은 reviewer가 수행합니다. Worker commit의 허용 파일은 origin metadata 한 파일만 정확히 늘립니다.
+- P2: 네 고정 법규 재감사 원문은 실제 모두 SBA이며 질문 lead는 positive입니다. YES/NO는 모든 option truth가 bool이고, 선언한 polarity가 실제 lead와 맞으며, polarity에 따른 true/false 집합이 complete expected key의 정확한 단일 보기와 일치해야 합니다. KEEP는 YES만 가능하고, AMBIGUOUS/NOT_ASSESSED는 명시적 HOLD/blocker를 요구합니다. 기존 key를 하드코딩하거나 바꾸지 않습니다.
+
+최종 집중59 PASS87.71초: actual native cached commit/submit/integrate, style-only PASS/FAIL와 공개15 default safety 혼합 경로, native-only/PENDING caller의 static inventory 보완, cache 변조/403/원시각/hash/사전 재독 거부, law4 null/false/극성/expected-set 모순 거부와 명시적 NO/AMBIGUOUS 처리를 포함합니다. 기존 공개15/native/source contracts114 PASS229.69초도 보존했습니다. 원본 기존 테스트와 assertion은 변경하지 않았습니다. 법규 기본 guard 및 기존 fixed2/38/native engine/네 정책은 그대로이며, 공개15의 이 typed dispatch 함수 변경만 이유와 함께 새 AST 증거로 기록합니다.
+
+새 scope 제안 SHA는05230f1a2f37443baf77dfc3d0ce336310a9d2d45bdf316525c8c8421345e8c4이며 대상146과 실제 reviewer identity는 같습니다. 이전 scope 제안은 비활성 역사 자료입니다. 실제 root plan/claim/audit/report/integration은 이 작업에서 실행하지 않았고 PASS/release credit0입니다. 전체 pytest/CI/배포 완료를 주장하지 않습니다.

+# 고정146/fixed4 native 보충 경로의 공학 증거
+
+실제 1차 보고서와 현재 객체를 읽어 최종 대상146개를 결박했습니다. 전체 현실성 pending142개는17 NOT_ASSESSED/97 EDITORIAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED/28 HOLD이며, 별도4 RW는 기존 flat-style PASS와 문맥 노출에 따른 key NOT_ASSESSED/HOLD를 유지한 법규 재감사 대상입니다. 처음 archive-only95 진단 원본을 보존하되 전체 현실성 census로 해석하지 않습니다. 4 RW에는 이미 nonlegacy safety hold가 있었으므로 알려진 negative 안내 누락4개라고 표시하지 않습니다.
+
+기준 engineering branch는8e0346a2이며 실제 read-only 제안 검증 소스는5e127485입니다. 원 raw primary PASS792와 기존 context38 조정 후 effective PASS788을 별도 보존합니다. 추가 fresh PASS는 고유 합집합으로만 가산하며, 원 HOLD28 및 기존 fixed2의 FAIL2는 새 PASS로 효과를 덮어쓰지 않습니다. 해당 두 이전 보충 보고서/row/hash/actor도 controller scope에 결박합니다. Fixed4 외 새 법규/key credit은0이고, fixed4의 실제 current-hash 판정만 최대4개 유일 집합에 추가할 수 있습니다.
+
+구현은 별도 state/scope/worker prefix와40/40/40/26 배정입니다. Native review_queue와 기존 fixed2/38 handler, notes published15 negative guard, 네 정책은 바이트 동일합니다. 기존 builder negative/default guard 함수 AST도 동일합니다. 새 통합은 별도 엄격 consumer와 실제 검증된 supplementary source binding만 연결합니다. Shared root/QA HEAD, 실제 queue, 원 질문·정답·사용자 이력·기존 보고서·배포 candidate는 변경하지 않았습니다.
+
+최종 의미 있는 검사:
+
+- 신규 native/controller/consumer38 PASS,40.09초: 실제 synthetic Git commit/branch/worker prefix·raw SHA·ordered integration·idempotence·얕은 clone·pending 무가산·author/exposure 차단·10 criteria/nearest439+2349 누락·변조·stale input·법규4 근거/옵션/hash·key 중복 차단·prior negative 보존·사전 판정이 checkout되지 않는 sparse worker view.
+- 기존 native queue/보충 source contracts82 PASS,14.44초. 원본 테스트·assertion을 바꾸지 않고 후보 모듈을 사용했습니다.
+
+이 수치는 engineering tests이며 실제 감사 PASS가 아닙니다. 실제 새 plan/claim/report/integration은0개이며 canonical RELEASED credit0입니다. `proposed-controller-scope-NOT_ACTIVATED.json`도 실제 state가 아닌 read-only 제안 증거입니다. Fresh reviewer는 이 controller 문서/기존 scope/보고서/원장 대신 별도 worker contract와 blinded packet만 받습니다.
+
+과거 prototype 실패도 보존했습니다. 첫 실패는 test PLAN의 wall clock이 synthetic CLAIM보다 늦어서 기존 revoke가 소급 시각을 올바르게 거부한 경우입니다. 두 번째는 JSON 공백만 바꿔 실제 question object hash가 동일한데 잘못 거부를 기대한 테스트입니다. 각 fixture를 실제 chronology/실제 stem 변경으로 고쳤고 생산 guard를 완화하지 않았습니다. 초기95 테스트 PASS는 superseded engineering 결과로만 보존합니다. 새 전체 pytest/CI/실제 audit·교정·배포 성공을 주장하지 않습니다.

+"""Finalize against real immutable integrated job69; never register controller state."""
+import copy,json,subprocess,sys
+from pathlib import Path
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4];sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts'))
+import note_review_queue as q
+import notes_census_reassessment as nr
+P='reports/full-corpus-review/final19-census-author/appendix-a-2-v2/'
+ROOT_BASE='b8cf09fad15fec320b1361652ae755e0d65725bb'
+INTEGRATED='95ef5df81a5118fc22d83b08478f84a68373ab95'
+INVENTORY=ROOT/(P+'own-head-strict-native-inventory.json')
+INVSHA=json.loads((ROOT/(P+'own-head-strict-native-inventory-proof.json')).read_bytes())['inventory_raw_sha256']
+def blob(commit,path):return subprocess.check_output(['git','show',commit+':'+path],cwd=ROOT)
+def write(path,obj):
+ dst=ROOT/path;dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dst.write_bytes(q.encoded(obj));return q.raw_sha(dst.read_bytes())
+materialized={}
+def materialize(path,sha=None):
+ if path not in materialized:
+  raw=blob('HEAD',path);dst=ROOT/path
+  if not dst.exists():dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dst.write_bytes(raw)
+  assert dst.read_bytes()==raw
+  materialized[path]=raw
+ if sha:assert q.raw_sha(materialized[path])==sha
+ return materialized[path]
+state=json.loads(materialize(q.STATE));assert materialized[q.STATE]==blob(ROOT_BASE,q.STATE);q.validate_state(state)
+prep=json.loads((ROOT/(P+'preparation-index.json')).read_bytes());uid=prep['unit_id'];job=nr.latest_jobs(state)[uid]
+assert job['sequence']==69 and job['status']=='INTEGRATED' and job['unit_bindings'][uid]==prep['original_binding']
+original_job=next(j for j in json.loads(blob(INTEGRATED,q.STATE))['jobs']if j['sequence']==69);assert q.digest(job)==q.digest(original_job)
+raw=INVENTORY.read_bytes();assert q.raw_sha(raw)==INVSHA;captured=json.loads(raw);notes=captured['notes'];assert captured['total_units']==306
+for binding in captured['units'].values():materialize(binding['census_path'],binding['census_sha256'])
+ledgerraw=materialize(q.LEDGER);assert q.raw_sha(ledgerraw)==captured['ledger_sha256']
+# Full native inventory, all306 units, all selected censuses; no projection or substitute ledger.
+current=q.inventory(ROOT,notes,ledger_raw=ledgerraw)
+assert current['total_units']==306 and current['units']==captured['units'] and current['ledger_sha256']==captured['ledger_sha256']
+assert current['units'][uid]==job['unit_bindings'][uid]
+actual={u['id']:u for ch in notes['chapters']for u in ch['units']};assert len(actual)==306
+for u,b in captured['units'].items():assert q.raw_sha(actual[u]['body'].encode())==b['body_sha256']
+result=job['result'];report=json.loads(materialize(result['evidence']['path'],result['evidence']['raw_sha256']));assert result['evidence']['raw_sha256']=='cb0ee3ba570aad46a836c73688d1cf6407321876ae53a42250956d7b2752314f'
+assert job['result_sha256']=='1eab75b5e9676f28ddabf48c88234486c77f62f6e7323a1dbf0883ebd0f33d96';materialize(result['result_path'],job['result_sha256'])
+assert (ROOT/(P+'inputs/report.json')).read_bytes()==materialized[result['evidence']['path']]
+for path,sha in q.validate_evidence(job,result,report):materialize(path,sha)
+for src in json.loads((ROOT/(P+'census.json')).read_bytes())['sources'].values():
+ if not src['source_evidence'].startswith(P):materialize(src['source_evidence'],src['source_evidence_sha256'])
+row=next(r for r in report['records']if r['unit_id']==uid);assert row['completeness']=='OMISSIONS_FOUND'and len(row['omissions'])==3
+fields={k:next(r for r in [json.loads(l)for l in ledgerraw.decode().splitlines()]if r['unit_id']==uid)[k]for k in nr.LEDGER_FIELDS};assert q.digest(fields)==prep['original_binding']['ledger_binding_sha256']
+census=json.loads((ROOT/(P+'census.json')).read_bytes());census['stage']='AUTHOR_PROPOSAL_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REASSESSMENT';csha=write(P+'final-census.json',census)

+원401초안/이전f842bundle/A32/B19/old9/final86불변도확인했다.
+
+MA PDF및eCFRHTML의원raw/text/meta6개는원workercommit→자체HEAD→disk가같다.

+제품/route로취급하거나 현재공급·법규schedule동일성·교부/처방권한을 인증하지 않는다.

Programmed delivery in vivo of 0.1, 0.2, or 0.3 mg clonidine per day, for one week. + + + Prescribing Information + + + +
+ + +
+ + + DESCRIPTION + + CATAPRES-TTS is a transdermal system providing continuous systemic delivery of clonidine for 7 days at an approximately constant rate. Clonidine is a centrally acting alpha-agonist hypotensive agent. It is an imidazoline derivative with the chemical name 2, 6-dichloro-N-2-imidazolidinylidenebenzenamine and has the following chemical structure: + CATAPRES
+ + + + + +
+ + + System Structure and Components + + CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system is a multi-layered film, 0.2 mm thick, containing clonidine as the active agent. The system areas are 3.5 cm2 (CATAPRES-TTS-1), 7.0 cm2 (CATAPRES-TTS-2) and 10.5 cm2 (CATAPRES-TTS-3) and the amount of drug released is directly proportional to the area (see + Release Rate Concept + ). The composition per unit area is the same for all three doses. + Proceeding from the visible surface towards the surface attached to the skin, there are four consecutive layers: 1) a backing layer of pigmented polyester and aluminum film; 2) a drug reservoir of clonidine, mineral oil, polyisobutylene, and colloidal silicon dioxide; 3) a microporous polypropylene membrane that controls the rate of delivery of clonidine from the system to the skin surface; 4) an adhesive formulation of clonidine, mineral oil, polyisobutylene, and colloidal silicon dioxide. Prior to use, a protective slit release liner of polyester that covers the adhesive layer is removed. + Cross Section of the System: + + + +
+ + +
+ + + Release Rate Concept + + Catapres-TTS® (clonidine) transdermal therapeutic system is programmed to release clonidine at an approximately constant rate for 7 days. The energy for drug release is derived from the concentration gradient existing between a saturated solution of drug in the system and the much lower concentration prevailing in the skin. Clonidine flows in the direction of the lower concentration at a constant rate, limited by the rate-controlling membrane, so long as a saturated solution is maintained in the drug reservoir. + Following system application to intact skin, clonidine in the adhesive layer saturates the skin site below the system. Clonidine from the drug reservoir then begins to flow through the rate-controlling membrane and the adhesive layer of the system into the systemic circulation via the capillaries beneath the skin. Therapeutic plasma clonidine levels are achieved 2 to 3 days after initial application of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system. + The 3.5, 7.0, and 10.5 cm2 systems deliver 0.1, 0.2, and 0.3 mg of clonidine per day, respectively. To ensure constant release of drug for 7 days, the total drug content of the system is higher than the total amount of drug delivered. Application of a new system to a fresh skin site at weekly intervals continuously maintains therapeutic plasma concentrations of clonidine. If the CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system is removed and not replaced with a new system, therapeutic plasma clonidine levels will persist for about 8 hours and then decline slowly over several days. Over this time period, blood pressure returns gradually to pretreatment levels. + + +

+ + +
+ + + CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY + + Clonidine stimulates alpha-adrenoreceptors in the brain stem. This action results in reduced sympathetic outflow from the central nervous system and in decreases in peripheral resistance, renal vascular resistance, heart rate, and blood pressure. Renal blood flow and glomerular filtration rate remain essentially unchanged. Normal postural reflexes are intact; therefore, orthostatic symptoms are mild and infrequent. + Acute studies with clonidine hydrochloride in humans have demonstrated a moderate reduction (15% - 20%) of cardiac output in the supine position with no change in the peripheral resistance; at a 45° tilt there is a smaller reduction in cardiac output and a decrease of peripheral resistance. + During long-term therapy, cardiac output tends to return to control values, while peripheral resistance remains decreased. Slowing of the pulse rate has been observed in most patients given clonidine, but the drug does not alter normal hemodynamic responses to exercise. + Tolerance to the antihypertensive effect may develop in some patients, necessitating a reevaluation of therapy. + Other studies in patients have provided evidence of a reduction in plasma renin activity and in the excretion of aldosterone and catecholamines. The exact relationship of these pharmacologic actions to the antihypertensive effect of clonidine has not been fully elucidated. + Clonidine acutely stimulates the release of growth hormone in children as well as adults but does not produce a chronic elevation of growth hormone with long-term use. + + + +
+ + + Pharmacokinetics + + The plasma half-life of clonidine is 12.7 ± 7 hours. Following oral administration, about 40-60% of the absorbed dose is recovered in the urine as unchanged drug within 24 hours. The remainder of the absorbed dose is metabolized in the liver. + + +
+ +
+ + +
+ + + INDICATIONS AND USAGE + + Catapres-TTS® (clonidine) transdermal therapeutic system is indicated in the treatment of hypertension. It may be employed alone or concomitantly with other antihypertensive agents. + + +
+ + +
+ + + CONTRAINDICATIONS + + CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system should not be used in patients with known hypersensitivity to clonidine or to any other component of the therapeutic system. + + +
+ + +
+ + + WARNINGS + + +
+ + + Withdrawal + + Patients should be instructed not to discontinue therapy without consulting their physician. Sudden cessation of clonidine treatment has, in some cases, resulted in symptoms such as nervousness, agitation, headache, and confusion accompanied or followed by a rapid rise in blood pressure and elevated catecholamine concentrations in the plasma. The likelihood of such reactions to discontinuation of clonidine therapy appears to be greater after administration of higher doses or continuation of concomitant beta-blocker treatment and special caution is therefore advised in these situations. Rare instances of hypertensive encephalopathy, cerebrovascular accidents and death have been reported after clonidine withdrawal. When discontinuing therapy with CATAPRES, the physician should reduce the dose gradually over 2 to 4 days to avoid withdrawal symptomatology. + An excessive rise in blood pressure following discontinuation of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system therapy can be reversed by administration of oral clonidine hydrochloride or by intravenous phentolamine. If therapy is to be discontinued in patients receiving a beta-blocker and clonidine concurrently, the beta-blocker should be withdrawn several days before the gradual discontinuation of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system. + + +
+ +
+ + +
+ + + PRECAUTIONS + + +
+ + + General + + In patients who have developed localized contact sensitization to CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system continuation of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system or substitution of oral clonidine hydrochloride therapy may be associated with development of a generalized skin rash. + In patients who develop an allergic reaction to CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system, substitution of oral clonidine hydrochloride may also elicit an allergic reaction (including generalized rash, urticaria, or angioedema). + CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system should be used with caution in patients with severe coronary insufficiency, conduction disturbances, recent myocardial infarction, cerebrovascular disease, or chronic renal failure. + In rare instances, loss of blood pressure control has been reported in patients using CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system according to the instructions for use. + + +
+ + +
+ + + Perioperative Use + + CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system therapy should not be interrupted during the surgical period. Blood pressure should be carefully monitored during surgery and additional measures to control blood pressure should be available if required. Physicians considering starting CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system therapy during the perioperative period must be aware that therapeutic plasma clonidine levels are not achieved until 2 to 3 days after initial application of Catapres-TTS® (clonidine) transdermal therapeutic system (see + DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION + ). + + +
+ + +
+ + + Defibrillation or Cardioversion + + The transdermal clonidine systems should be removed before attempting defibrillation or cardioversion because of the potential for altered electrical conductivity which may increase the risk of arcing, a phenomenon associated with the use of defibrillators. + + +
+ + +
+ + + MRI + + Skin burns have been reported at the patch site in several patients wearing an aluminized transdermal system during a magnetic resonance imaging scan (MRI). Because the CATAPRES-TTS PATCH contains aluminum, it is recommended to remove the system before undergoing an MRI. + + +
+ + +
+ + + Information for Patients + + Patients should be cautioned against interruption of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system therapy without their physician’s advice. + Patients who engage in potentially hazardous activities, such as operating machinery or driving, should be advised of a possible sedative effect of clonidine. They should also be informed that this sedative effect may be increased by concomitant use of alcohol, barbiturates, or other sedating drugs. + Patients who wear contact lenses should be cautioned that treatment with CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system may cause dryness of eyes. + Patients should be instructed to consult their physicians promptly about the possible need to remove the patch if they observe moderate to severe localized erythema and/or vesicle formation at the site of application or generalized skin rash. + If a patient experiences isolated, mild localized skin irritation before completing 7 days of use, the system may be removed and replaced with a new system applied to a fresh skin site. + If the system should begin to loosen from the skin after application, the patient should be instructed to place the adhesive cover directly over the system to ensure adhesion during its 7-day use. + Used CATAPRES-TTS PATCHES contain a substantial amount of their initial drug content which may be harmful to infants and children if accidentally applied or ingested. THEREFORE, PATIENTS SHOULD BE CAUTIONED TO KEEP BOTH USED AND UNUSED CATAPRES-TTS PATCHES OUT OF THE REACH OF CHILDREN. After use, CATAPRES-TTS should be folded in half with the adhesive sides together and discarded away from children’s reach. + Instructions for use, storage and disposal of the system are provided at the end of this monograph. These instructions are also included in each box of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system. + + +
+ + +
+ + + Drug Interactions + + Clonidine may potentiate the CNS-depressive effects of alcohol, barbiturates or other sedating drugs. If a patient receiving clonidine is also taking tricyclic antidepressants, the hypotensive effect of clonidine may be reduced, necessitating an increase in the clonidine dose. + Monitor heart rate in patients receiving clonidine concomitantly with agents known to affect sinus node function or AV nodal conduction e.g., digitalis, calcium channel blockers, and beta-blockers. Sinus bradycardia resulting in hospitalization and pacemaker insertion has been reported in association with the use of clonidine concomitantly with diltiazem or verapamil. + Amitriptyline in combination with clonidine enhances the manifestation of corneal lesions in rats (see + Toxicology + ). + + +
+ + +
+ + + Toxicology + + In several studies with oral clonidine hydrochloride, a dose-dependent increase in the incidence and severity of spontaneous retinal degeneration was seen in albino rats treated for six months or longer. Tissue distribution studies in dogs and monkeys showed a concentration of clonidine in the choroid. + In view of the retinal degeneration seen in rats, eye examinations were performed during clinical trials in 908 patients before, and periodically after, the start of clonidine therapy. In 353 of these 908 patients, the eye examinations were carried out over periods of 24 months or longer. Except for some dryness of the eyes, no drug-related abnormal ophthalmological findings were recorded and, according to specialized tests such as electroretinography and macular dazzle, retinal function was unchanged. + In combination with amitriptyline, clonidine hydrochloride administration led to the development of corneal lesions in rats within 5 days. + + +
+ + +
+ + + Carcinogenesis, Mutagenesis, Impairment of Fertility + + Chronic dietary administration of clonidine was not carcinogenic to rats (132 weeks) or mice (78 weeks) dosed, respectively, at up to 46 to 70 times the maximum recommended daily human dose as mg/kg (9 or 6 times the MRDHD on a mg/m2 basis). There was no evidence of genotoxicity in the Ames test for mutagenicity or mouse micronucleus test for clastogenicity. + Fertility of male and female rats was unaffected by clonidine doses as high as 150 mcg/kg (approximately 3 times the MRDHD). In a separate experiment, fertility of female rats appeared to be affected at dose levels of 500 to 2000 mcg/kg (10 to 40 times the oral MRDHD on a mg/kg basis; 2 to 8 times the MRDHD on a mg/m2 basis). + + +
+ + +
+ + + Pregnancy + + +
+ + + + + Teratogenic Effects: + Pregnancy Category C. + + Reproduction studies performed in rabbits at doses up to approximately 3 times the oral maximum recommended daily human dose (MRDHD) of CATAPRES® (clonidine hydrochloride) produced no evidence of a teratogenic or embryotoxic potential in rabbits. In rats, however, doses as low as 1/3 the oral MRDHD (1/15 the MRDHD on a mg/m2 basis) of clonidine were associated with increased resorptions in a study in which dams were treated continuously from 2 months prior to mating. Increased resorptions were not associated with treatment at the same or at higher dose levels (up to 3 times the oral MRDHD) when the dams were treated on gestation days 6–15. Increases in resorption were observed at much higher dose levels (40 times the oral MRDHD on a mg/kg basis; 4 to 8 times the MRDHD on a mg/m2 basis) in mice and rats treated on gestation days 1–14 (lowest dose employed in the study was 500 mcg/kg). + No adequate well-controlled studies have been conducted in pregnant women. Because animal reproduction studies are not always predictive of human response, this drug should be used during pregnancy only if clearly needed. + + +
+ +
+ + +
+ + + Nursing Mothers + + As clonidine is excreted in human milk, caution should be exercised when Catapres-TTS® (clonidine) transdermal therapeutic system is administered to a nursing woman. + + +
+ + +
+ + + Pediatric Use + + Safety and effectiveness in pediatric patients have not been established in adequate and well-controlled trials (see + WARNINGS, Withdrawal + ). + + +
+ +
+ + +
+ + + ADVERSE REACTIONS + + +
+ + + Clinical trial experience with CATAPRES-TTS + + Most systemic adverse effects during Catapres-TTS® (clonidine) transdermal therapeutic system therapy have been mild and have tended to diminish with continued therapy. In a 3-month multi-clinic trial of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system in 101 hypertensive patients, the systemic adverse reactions were, dry mouth (25 patients) and drowsiness (12), fatigue (6), headache (5), lethargy and sedation (3 each), insomnia, dizziness, impotence/sexual dysfunction, dry throat (2 each) and constipation, nausea, change in taste and nervousness (1 each). + In the above mentioned 3-month controlled clinical trial, as well as other uncontrolled clinical trials, the most frequent adverse reactions were dermatological and are described below. + In the 3-month trial, 51 of the 101 patients had localized skin reactions such as erythema (26 patients) and/or pruritus, particularly after using an adhesive cover throughout the 7-day dosage interval. Allergic contact sensitization to CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system was observed in 5 patients. Other skin reactions were localized vesiculation (7 patients), hyperpigmentation (5), edema (3), excoriation (3), burning (3), papules (1), throbbing (1), blanching (1), and a generalized macular rash (1). + In additional clinical experience, contact dermatitis resulting in treatment discontinuation was observed in 128 of 673 patients (about 19 in 100) after a mean duration of treatment of 37 weeks. The incidence of contact dermatitis was about 34 in 100 among white women, about 18 in 100 in white men, about 14 in 100 in black women, and approximately 8 in 100 in black men. Analysis of skin reaction data showed that the risk of having to discontinue CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system treatment because of contact dermatitis was greatest between treatment weeks 6 and 26, although sensitivity may develop either earlier or later in treatment. + In a large-scale clinical acceptability and safety study by 451 physicians in a total of 3539 patients, other allergic reactions were recorded for which a causal relationship to CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system was not established: maculopapular rash (10 cases); urticaria (2 cases); and angioedema of the face (2 cases), which also affected the tongue in one of the patients. + + +
+ + +
+ + + Marketing Experience with CATAPRES-TTS + + The following adverse reactions have been identified during post-approval use of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system. Because these reactions are reported voluntarily from a population of uncertain size, it is not always possible to estimate reliably their frequency or establish a causal relationship to drug exposure. Decisions to include these reactions in labeling are typically based on one or more of the following factors: (1) seriousness of the reaction, (2) frequency of reporting, or (3) strength of causal connection to CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system. + + Body as a Whole: Fever; malaise; weakness; pallor; and withdrawal syndrome. + + Cardiovascular: Congestive heart failure; cerebrovascular accident; electrocardiographic abnormalities (i.e., bradycardia, sick sinus syndrome disturbances and arrhythmias); chest pain; orthostatic symptoms; syncope; increases in blood pressure; sinus bradycardia and atrioventricular (AV) block with and without the use of concomitant digitalis; Raynaud’s phenomenon; tachycardia; bradycardia; and palpitations. + + Central and Peripheral Nervous System/Psychiatric: Delirium; mental depression; hallucinations (including visual and auditory); localized numbness; vivid dreams or nightmares; restlessness; anxiety; agitation; irritability; other behavioral changes; and drowsiness. + + Dermatological: Angioneurotic edema; localized or generalized rash; hives; urticaria; contact dermatitis; pruritus; alopecia; and localized hypo or hyper pigmentation. + + Gastrointestinal: Anorexia and vomiting. + + Genitourinary: Difficult micturition; loss of libido; and decreased sexual activity. + + Metabolic: Gynecomastia or breast enlargement and weight gain. + + Musculoskeletal: Muscle or joint pain; and leg cramps. + + Ophthalmological: Blurred vision; burning of the eyes and dryness of the eyes. + + Adverse Events Associated with Oral CATAPRES Therapy: Most adverse effects are mild and tend to diminish with continued therapy. The most frequent (which appear to be dose-related) are dry mouth, occurring in about 40 of 100 patients; drowsiness, about 33 in 100; dizziness, about 16 in 100; constipation and sedation, each about 10 in 100. The following less frequent adverse experiences have also been reported in patients receiving CATAPRES (clonidine hydrochloride, USP) tablets, but in many cases patients were receiving concomitant medication and a causal relationship has not been established. + + Body as a Whole: Fatigue, fever, headache, pallor, weakness, and withdrawal syndrome. Also reported were a weakly positive Coombs’ test and increased sensitivity to alcohol. + + Cardiovascular: Bradycardia, congestive heart failure, electrocardiographic abnormalities (i.e., sinus node arrest, junctional bradycardia, high degree AV block and arrhythmias), orthostatic symptoms, palpitations, Raynaud’s phenomenon, syncope, and tachycardia. Cases of sinus bradycardia and AV block have been reported, both with and without the use of concomitant digitalis. + + Central Nervous System: Agitation, anxiety, delirium, delusional perception, hallucinations (including visual and auditory), insomnia, mental depression, nervousness, other behavioral changes, paresthesia, restlessness, sleep disorder, and vivid dreams or nightmares. + + Dermatological: Alopecia, angioneurotic edema, hives, pruritus, rash, and urticaria. + + Gastrointestinal: Abdominal pain, anorexia, constipation, hepatitis, malaise, mild transient abnormalities in liver function tests, nausea, parotitis, pseudo-obstruction (including colonic pseudo-obstruction), salivary gland pain, and vomiting. + + Genitourinary: Decreased sexual activity, difficulty in micturition, erectile dysfunction, loss of libido, nocturia, and urinary retention. + + Hematologic: Thrombocytopenia. + + Metabolic: Gynecomastia, transient elevation of blood glucose or serum creatine phosphokinase, and weight gain. + + Musculoskeletal: Leg cramps and muscle or joint pain. + + Oro-otolaryngeal: Dryness of the nasal mucosa. + + Ophthalmological: Accommodation disorder, blurred vision, burning of the eyes, decreased lacrimation, and dryness of the eyes. + + +
+ +
+ + +
+ + + OVERDOSAGE + + Hypertension may develop early and may be followed by hypotension, bradycardia, respiratory depression, hypothermia, drowsiness, decreased or absent reflexes, weakness, irritability and miosis. The frequency of CNS depression may be higher in children than adults. Large overdoses may result in reversible cardiac conduction defects or dysrhythmias, apnea, coma and seizures. Signs and symptoms of overdose generally occur within 30 minutes to two hours after exposure. As little as 0.1 mg of clonidine has produced signs of toxicity in children. + If symptoms of poisoning occur following dermal exposure, remove all Catapres-TTS® (clonidine) transdermal therapeutic systems. After their removal, the plasma clonidine levels will persist for about 8 hours, then decline slowly over a period of several days. Rare cases of CATAPRES-TTS poisoning due to accidental or deliberate mouthing or ingestion of the patch have been reported, many of them involving children. + There is no specific antidote for clonidine overdosage. Ipecac syrup-induced vomiting and gastric lavage would not be expected to remove significant amounts of clonidine following dermal exposure. If the patch is ingested, whole bowel irrigation may be considered and the administration of activated charcoal and/or cathartic may be beneficial. Supportive care may include atropine sulfate for bradycardia, intravenous fluids and/or vasopressor agents for hypotension and vasodilators for hypertension. Naloxone may be a useful adjunct for the management of clonidine-induced respiratory depression, hypotension and/or coma; blood pressure should be monitored since the administration of naloxone has occasionally resulted in paradoxical hypertension. Tolazoline administration has yielded inconsistent results and is not recommended as first-line therapy. Dialysis is not likely to significantly enhance the elimination of clonidine. + The largest overdose reported to date, involved a 28-year old male who ingested 100 mg of clonidine hydrochloride powder. This patient developed hypertension followed by hypotension, bradycardia, apnea, hallucinations, semicoma, and premature ventricular contractions. The patient fully recovered after intensive treatment. Plasma clonidine levels were 60 ng/mL after 1 hour, 190 ng/mL after 1.5 hours, 370 ng/mL after 2 hours, and 120 ng/mL after 5.5 and 6.5 hours. In mice and rats, the oral LD50 of clonidine is 206 and 465 mg/kg, respectively. + + +
+ + +
+ + + DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION + + Apply CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system once every 7 days to a hairless area of intact skin on the upper outer arm or chest. Each new application of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system should be on a different skin site from the previous location. If the system loosens during 7-day wearing, the adhesive cover should be applied directly over the system to ensure good adhesion. There have been rare reports of the need for patch changes prior to 7 days to maintain blood pressure control. + To initiate therapy, CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system dosage should be titrated according to individual therapeutic requirements, starting with CATAPRES-TTS-1. If after one or two weeks the desired reduction in blood pressure is not achieved, increase the dosage by adding another CATAPRES-TTS-1 or changing to a larger system. An increase in dosage above two CATAPRES-TTS-3 is usually not associated with additional efficacy. + When substituting CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system for oral clonidine or for other antihypertensive drugs, physicians should be aware that the antihypertensive effect of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system may not commence until 2-3 days after initial application. Therefore, gradual reduction of prior drug dosage is advised. Some or all previous antihypertensive treatment may have to be continued, particularly in patients with more severe forms of hypertension. + + + +
+ + + Renal Impairment + + Dosage must be adjusted according to the degree of impairment, and patients should be carefully monitored. Since only a minimal amount of clonidine is removed during routine hemodialysis, there is no need to give supplemental clonidine following dialysis. + + +

+DESCRIPTION
+CATAPRES-TTS is a transdermal system providing continuous systemic delivery of clonidine for 7 days at an approximately constant rate. Clonidine is a centrally acting alpha-agonist hypotensive agent. Prior to use, a protective slit release liner of polyester that covers the adhesive layer is removed.

+Release Rate Concept
+Catapres-TTS® (clonidine) transdermal therapeutic system is programmed to release clonidine at an approximately constant rate for 7 days. The energy for drug release is derived from the concentration gradient existing between a saturated solution of drug in the system and the much lower concentration prevailing in the skin. Clonidine flows in the direction of the lower concentration at a constant rate, limited by the rate-controlling membrane, so long as a saturated solution is maintained in the drug reservoir.
+Following system application to intact skin, clonidine in the adhesive layer saturates the skin site below the system. Clonidine from the drug reservoir then begins to flow through the rate-controlling membrane and the adhesive layer of the system into the systemic circulation via the capillaries beneath the skin. Therapeutic plasma clonidine levels are achieved 2 to 3 days after initial application of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system.
+The 3.5, 7.0, and 10.5 cm
+2
+systems deliver 0.1, 0.2, and 0.3 mg of clonidine per day, respectively. To ensure constant release of drug for 7 days, the total drug content of the system is higher than the total amount of drug delivered. Application of a new system to a fresh skin site at weekly intervals continuously maintains therapeutic plasma concentrations of clonidine. If the CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system is removed and not replaced with a new system, therapeutic plasma clonidine levels will persist for about 8 hours and then decline slowly over several days. Over this time period, blood pressure returns gradually to pretreatment levels.

+CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY
+Clonidine stimulates alpha-adrenoreceptors in the brain stem. This action results in reduced sympathetic outflow from the central nervous system and in decreases in peripheral resistance, renal vascular resistance, heart rate, and blood pressure. Renal blood flow and glomerular filtration rate remain essentially unchanged. Normal postural reflexes are intact; therefore, orthostatic symptoms are mild and infrequent.
+Acute studies with clonidine hydrochloride in humans have demonstrated a moderate reduction (15% - 20%) of cardiac output in the supine position with no change in the peripheral resistance; at a 45° tilt there is a smaller reduction in cardiac output and a decrease of peripheral resistance.
+During long-term therapy, cardiac output tends to return to control values, while peripheral resistance remains decreased. Slowing of the pulse rate has been observed in most patients given clonidine, but the drug does not alter normal hemodynamic responses to exercise.
+Tolerance to the antihypertensive effect may develop in some patients, necessitating a reevaluation of therapy.
+Other studies in patients have provided evidence of a reduction in plasma renin activity and in the excretion of aldosterone and catecholamines. The exact relationship of these pharmacologic actions to the antihypertensive effect of clonidine has not been fully elucidated.
+Clonidine acutely stimulates the release of growth hormone in children as well as adults but does not produce a chronic elevation of growth hormone with long-term use.
+Pharmacokinetics
+The plasma half-life of clonidine is 12.7 ± 7 hours. Following oral administration, about 40-60% of the absorbed dose is recovered in the urine as unchanged drug within 24 hours. The remainder of the absorbed dose is metabolized in the liver.
+INDICATIONS AND USAGE
+Catapres-TTS® (clonidine) transdermal therapeutic system is indicated in the treatment of hypertension. It may be employed alone or concomitantly with other antihypertensive agents.
+CONTRAINDICATIONS
+CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system should not be used in patients with known hypersensitivity to clonidine or to any other component of the therapeutic system.
+WARNINGS
+Withdrawal
+Patients should be instructed not to discontinue therapy without consulting their physician. Sudden cessation of clonidine treatment has, in some cases, resulted in symptoms such as nervousness, agitation, headache, and confusion accompanied or followed by a rapid rise in blood pressure and elevated catecholamine concentrations in the plasma. The likelihood of such reactions to discontinuation of clonidine therapy appears to be greater after administration of higher doses or continuation of concomitant beta-blocker treatment and special caution is therefore advised in these situations. Rare instances of hypertensive encephalopathy, cerebrovascular accidents and death have been reported after clonidine withdrawal. When discontinuing therapy with CATAPRES, the physician should reduce the dose gradually over 2 to 4 days to avoid withdrawal symptomatology.
+An excessive rise in blood pressure following discontinuation of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system therapy can be reversed by administration of oral clonidine hydrochloride or by intravenous phentolamine. If therapy is to be discontinued in patients receiving a beta-blocker and clonidine concurrently, the beta-blocker should be withdrawn several days before the gradual discontinuation of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system.
+PRECAUTIONS
+General
+In patients who have developed localized contact sensitization to CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system continuation of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system or substitution of oral clonidine hydrochloride therapy may be associated with development of a generalized skin rash.
+In patients who develop an allergic reaction to CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system, substitution of oral clonidine hydrochloride may also elicit an allergic reaction (including generalized rash, urticaria, or angioedema).
+CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system should be used with caution in patients with severe coronary insufficiency, conduction disturbances, recent myocardial infarction, cerebrovascular disease, or chronic renal failure.
+In rare instances, loss of blood pressure control has been reported in patients using CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system according to the instructions for use.
+Perioperative Use
+CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system therapy should not be interrupted during the surgical period. Blood pressure should be carefully monitored during surgery and additional measures to control blood pressure should be available if required. Physicians considering starting CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system therapy during the perioperative period must be aware that therapeutic plasma clonidine levels are not achieved until 2 to 3 days after initial application of Catapres-TTS® (clonidine) transdermal therapeutic system (see
+DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION
+).
+Defibrillation or Cardioversion
+The transdermal clonidine systems should be removed before attempting defibrillation or cardioversion because of the potential for altered electrical conductivity which may increase the risk of arcing, a phenomenon associated with the use of defibrillators.
+MRI
+Skin burns have been reported at the patch site in several patients wearing an aluminized transdermal system during a magnetic resonance imaging scan (MRI). Because the CATAPRES-TTS PATCH contains aluminum, it is recommended to remove the system before undergoing an MRI.
+Information for Patients
+Patients should be cautioned against interruption of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system therapy without their physician’s advice.
+Patients who engage in potentially hazardous activities, such as operating machinery or driving, should be advised of a possible sedative effect of clonidine. They should also be informed that this sedative effect may be increased by concomitant use of alcohol, barbiturates, or other sedating drugs.
+Patients who wear contact lenses should be cautioned that treatment with CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system may cause dryness of eyes.
+Patients should be instructed to consult their physicians promptly about the possible need to remove the patch if they observe moderate to severe localized erythema and/or vesicle formation at the site of application or generalized skin rash.
+If a patient experiences isolated, mild localized skin irritation before completing 7 days of use, the system may be removed and replaced with a new system applied to a fresh skin site.
+If the system should begin to loosen from the skin after application, the patient should be instructed to place the adhesive cover directly over the system to ensure adhesion during its 7-day use.
+Used CATAPRES-TTS PATCHES contain a substantial amount of their initial drug content which may be harmful to infants and children if accidentally applied or ingested. THEREFORE, PATIENTS SHOULD BE CAUTIONED TO KEEP BOTH USED AND UNUSED CATAPRES-TTS PATCHES OUT OF THE REACH OF CHILDREN. After use, CATAPRES-TTS should be folded in half with the adhesive sides together and discarded away from children’s reach.
+Instructions for use, storage and disposal of the system are provided at the end of this monograph. These instructions are also included in each box of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system.
+Drug Interactions
+Clonidine may potentiate the CNS-depressive effects of alcohol, barbiturates or other sedating drugs. If a patient receiving clonidine is also taking tricyclic antidepressants, the hypotensive effect of clonidine may be reduced, necessitating an increase in the clonidine dose.
+Monitor heart rate in patients receiving clonidine concomitantly with agents known to affect sinus node function or AV nodal conduction e.g., digitalis, calcium channel blockers, and beta-blockers. Sinus bradycardia resulting in hospitalization and pacemaker insertion has been reported in association with the use of clonidine concomitantly with diltiazem or verapamil.
+Amitriptyline in combination with clonidine enhances the manifestation of corneal lesions in rats (see
+Toxicology
+).
+Toxicology
+In several studies with oral clonidine hydrochloride, a dose-dependent increase in the incidence and severity of spontaneous retinal degeneration was seen in albino rats treated for six months or longer. Tissue distribution studies in dogs and monkeys showed a concentration of clonidine in the choroid.
+In view of the retinal degeneration seen in rats, eye examinations were performed during clinical trials in 908 patients before, and periodically after, the start of clonidine therapy. In 353 of these 908 patients, the eye examinations were carried out over periods of 24 months or longer. Except for some dryness of the eyes, no drug-related abnormal ophthalmological findings were recorded and, according to specialized tests such as electroretinography and macular dazzle, retinal function was unchanged.
+In combination with amitriptyline, clonidine hydrochloride administration led to the development of corneal lesions in rats within 5 days.
+Carcinogenesis, Mutagenesis, Impairment of Fertility
+Chronic dietary administration of clonidine was not carcinogenic to rats (132 weeks) or mice (78 weeks) dosed, respectively, at up to 46 to 70 times the maximum recommended daily human dose as mg/kg (9 or 6 times the MRDHD on a mg/m
+2
+basis). There was no evidence of genotoxicity in the Ames test for mutagenicity or mouse micronucleus test for clastogenicity.
+Fertility of male and female rats was unaffected by clonidine doses as high as 150 mcg/kg (approximately 3 times the MRDHD). In a separate experiment, fertility of female rats appeared to be affected at dose levels of 500 to 2000 mcg/kg (10 to 40 times the oral MRDHD on a mg/kg basis; 2 to 8 times the MRDHD on a mg/m
+2
+basis).
+Pregnancy
+Teratogenic Effects:
+Pregnancy Category C.
+Reproduction studies performed in rabbits at doses up to approximately 3 times the oral maximum recommended daily human dose (MRDHD) of CATAPRES® (clonidine hydrochloride) produced no evidence of a teratogenic or embryotoxic potential in rabbits. In rats, however, doses as low as 1/3 the oral MRDHD (1/15 the MRDHD on a mg/m
+2
+basis) of clonidine were associated with increased resorptions in a study in which dams were treated continuously from 2 months prior to mating. Increased resorptions were not associated with treatment at the same or at higher dose levels (up to 3 times the oral MRDHD) when the dams were treated on gestation days 6–15. Increases in resorption were observed at much higher dose levels (40 times the oral MRDHD on a mg/kg basis; 4 to 8 times the MRDHD on a mg/m
+2
+basis) in mice and rats treated on gestation days 1–14 (lowest dose employed in the study was 500 mcg/kg).
+No adequate well-controlled studies have been conducted in pregnant women. Because animal reproduction studies are not always predictive of human response, this drug should be used during pregnancy only if clearly needed.
+Nursing Mothers
+As clonidine is excreted in human milk, caution should be exercised when Catapres-TTS® (clonidine) transdermal therapeutic system is administered to a nursing woman.
+Pediatric Use
+Safety and effectiveness in pediatric patients have not been established in adequate and well-controlled trials (see
+WARNINGS, Withdrawal
+).
+ADVERSE REACTIONS
+Clinical trial experience with CATAPRES-TTS
+Most systemic adverse effects during Catapres-TTS® (clonidine) transdermal therapeutic system therapy have been mild and have tended to diminish with continued therapy. In a 3-month multi-clinic trial of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system in 101 hypertensive patients, the systemic adverse reactions were, dry mouth (25 patients) and drowsiness (12), fatigue (6), headache (5), lethargy and sedation (3 each), insomnia, dizziness, impotence/sexual dysfunction, dry throat (2 each) and constipation, nausea, change in taste and nervousness (1 each).
+In the above mentioned 3-month controlled clinical trial, as well as other uncontrolled clinical trials, the most frequent adverse reactions were dermatological and are described below.
+In the 3-month trial, 51 of the 101 patients had localized skin reactions such as erythema (26 patients) and/or pruritus, particularly after using an adhesive cover throughout the 7-day dosage interval. Allergic contact sensitization to CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system was observed in 5 patients. Other skin reactions were localized vesiculation (7 patients), hyperpigmentation (5), edema (3), excoriation (3), burning (3), papules (1), throbbing (1), blanching (1), and a generalized macular rash (1).
+In additional clinical experience, contact dermatitis resulting in treatment discontinuation was observed in 128 of 673 patients (about 19 in 100) after a mean duration of treatment of 37 weeks. The incidence of contact dermatitis was about 34 in 100 among white women, about 18 in 100 in white men, about 14 in 100 in black women, and approximately 8 in 100 in black men. Analysis of skin reaction data showed that the risk of having to discontinue CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system treatment because of contact dermatitis was greatest between treatment weeks 6 and 26, although sensitivity may develop either earlier or later in treatment.
+In a large-scale clinical acceptability and safety study by 451 physicians in a total of 3539 patients, other allergic reactions were recorded for which a causal relationship to CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system was not established: maculopapular rash (10 cases); urticaria (2 cases); and angioedema of the face (2 cases), which also affected the tongue in one of the patients.
+Marketing Experience with CATAPRES-TTS
+The following adverse reactions have been identified during post-approval use of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system. Because these reactions are reported voluntarily from a population of uncertain size, it is not always possible to estimate reliably their frequency or establish a causal relationship to drug exposure. Decisions to include these reactions in labeling are typically based on one or more of the following factors: (1) seriousness of the reaction, (2) frequency of reporting, or (3) strength of causal connection to CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system.
+Body as a Whole:
+Fever; malaise; weakness; pallor; and withdrawal syndrome.
+Cardiovascular:
+Congestive heart failure; cerebrovascular accident; electrocardiographic abnormalities (i.e., bradycardia, sick sinus syndrome disturbances and arrhythmias); chest pain; orthostatic symptoms; syncope; increases in blood pressure; sinus bradycardia and atrioventricular (AV) block with and without the use of concomitant digitalis; Raynaud’s phenomenon; tachycardia; bradycardia; and palpitations.
+Central and Peripheral Nervous System/Psychiatric:
+Delirium; mental depression; hallucinations (including visual and auditory); localized numbness; vivid dreams or nightmares; restlessness; anxiety; agitation; irritability; other behavioral changes; and drowsiness.
+Dermatological:
+Angioneurotic edema; localized or generalized rash; hives; urticaria; contact dermatitis; pruritus; alopecia; and localized hypo or hyper pigmentation.
+Gastrointestinal:
+Anorexia and vomiting.
+Genitourinary:
+Difficult micturition; loss of libido; and decreased sexual activity.
+Metabolic:
+Gynecomastia or breast enlargement and weight gain.
+Musculoskeletal:
+Muscle or joint pain; and leg cramps.
+Ophthalmological:
+Blurred vision; burning of the eyes and dryness of the eyes.
+Adverse Events Associated with Oral CATAPRES Therapy:
+Most adverse effects are mild and tend to diminish with continued therapy. The most frequent (which appear to be dose-related) are dry mouth, occurring in about 40 of 100 patients; drowsiness, about 33 in 100; dizziness, about 16 in 100; constipation and sedation, each about 10 in 100. The following less frequent adverse experiences have also been reported in patients receiving CATAPRES (clonidine hydrochloride, USP) tablets, but in many cases patients were receiving concomitant medication and a causal relationship has not been established.
+Body as a Whole:
+Fatigue, fever, headache, pallor, weakness, and withdrawal syndrome. Also reported were a weakly positive Coombs’ test and increased sensitivity to alcohol.
+Cardiovascular:
+Bradycardia, congestive heart failure, electrocardiographic abnormalities (i.e., sinus node arrest, junctional bradycardia, high degree AV block and arrhythmias), orthostatic symptoms, palpitations, Raynaud’s phenomenon, syncope, and tachycardia. Cases of sinus bradycardia and AV block have been reported, both with and without the use of concomitant digitalis.
+Central Nervous System:
+Agitation, anxiety, delirium, delusional perception, hallucinations (including visual and auditory), insomnia, mental depression, nervousness, other behavioral changes, paresthesia, restlessness, sleep disorder, and vivid dreams or nightmares.
+Dermatological:
+Alopecia, angioneurotic edema, hives, pruritus, rash, and urticaria.
+Gastrointestinal:
+Abdominal pain, anorexia, constipation, hepatitis, malaise, mild transient abnormalities in liver function tests, nausea, parotitis, pseudo-obstruction (including colonic pseudo-obstruction), salivary gland pain, and vomiting.
+Genitourinary:
+Decreased sexual activity, difficulty in micturition, erectile dysfunction, loss of libido, nocturia, and urinary retention.
+Hematologic:
+Thrombocytopenia.
+Metabolic:
+Gynecomastia, transient elevation of blood glucose or serum creatine phosphokinase, and weight gain.
+Musculoskeletal:
+Leg cramps and muscle or joint pain.
+Oro-otolaryngeal:
+Dryness of the nasal mucosa.
+Ophthalmological:
+Accommodation disorder, blurred vision, burning of the eyes, decreased lacrimation, and dryness of the eyes.
+OVERDOSAGE
+Hypertension may develop early and may be followed by hypotension, bradycardia, respiratory depression, hypothermia, drowsiness, decreased or absent reflexes, weakness, irritability and miosis. The frequency of CNS depression may be higher in children than adults. Large overdoses may result in reversible cardiac conduction defects or dysrhythmias, apnea, coma and seizures. Signs and symptoms of overdose generally occur within 30 minutes to two hours after exposure. As little as 0.1 mg of clonidine has produced signs of toxicity in children.
+If symptoms of poisoning occur following dermal exposure, remove all Catapres-TTS® (clonidine) transdermal therapeutic systems. After their removal, the plasma clonidine levels will persist for about 8 hours, then decline slowly over a period of several days. Rare cases of CATAPRES-TTS poisoning due to accidental or deliberate mouthing or ingestion of the patch have been reported, many of them involving children.
+There is no specific antidote for clonidine overdosage. Ipecac syrup-induced vomiting and gastric lavage would not be expected to remove significant amounts of clonidine following dermal exposure. If the patch is ingested, whole bowel irrigation may be considered and the administration of activated charcoal and/or cathartic may be beneficial. Supportive care may include atropine sulfate for bradycardia, intravenous fluids and/or vasopressor agents for hypotension and vasodilators for hypertension. Naloxone may be a useful adjunct for the management of clonidine-induced respiratory depression, hypotension and/or coma; blood pressure should be monitored since the administration of naloxone has occasionally resulted in paradoxical hypertension. Tolazoline administration has yielded inconsistent results and is not recommended as first-line therapy. Dialysis is not likely to significantly enhance the elimination of clonidine.
+The largest overdose reported to date, involved a 28-year old male who ingested 100 mg of clonidine hydrochloride powder. This patient developed hypertension followed by hypotension, bradycardia, apnea, hallucinations, semicoma, and premature ventricular contractions. The patient fully recovered after intensive treatment. Plasma clonidine levels were 60 ng/mL after 1 hour, 190 ng/mL after 1.5 hours, 370 ng/mL after 2 hours, and 120 ng/mL after 5.5 and 6.5 hours. In mice and rats, the oral LD
+50
+of clonidine is 206 and 465 mg/kg, respectively.
+DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION
+Apply CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system once every 7 days to a hairless area of intact skin on the upper outer arm or chest. Each new application of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system should be on a different skin site from the previous location. If the system loosens during 7-day wearing, the adhesive cover should be applied directly over the system to ensure good adhesion. There have been rare reports of the need for patch changes prior to 7 days to maintain blood pressure control.
+To initiate therapy, CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system dosage should be titrated according to individual therapeutic requirements, starting with CATAPRES-TTS-1. If after one or two weeks the desired reduction in blood pressure is not achieved, increase the dosage by adding another CATAPRES-TTS-1 or changing to a larger system. An increase in dosage above two CATAPRES-TTS-3 is usually not associated with additional efficacy.
+When substituting CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system for oral clonidine or for other antihypertensive drugs, physicians should be aware that the antihypertensive effect of CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system may not commence until 2-3 days after initial application. Therefore, gradual reduction of prior drug dosage is advised. Some or all previous antihypertensive treatment may have to be continued, particularly in patients with more severe forms of hypertension.
+Renal Impairment
+Dosage must be adjusted according to the degree of impairment, and patients should be carefully monitored. Since only a minimal amount of clonidine is removed during routine hemodialysis, there is no need to give supplemental clonidine following dialysis.

+PATIENT INSTRUCTIONS
+Catapres-TTS®
+(clonidine)
+Transdermal Therapeutic System
+(Read the following instructions carefully before using this medication. If you have any questions, please consult with your doctor.)
+General Information
+CATAPRES-TTS transdermal therapeutic system is a square, tan adhesive PATCH containing an active blood-pressure-lowering medication. It is designed to deliver the drug into the body through the skin smoothly and consistently for one full week. Normal exposure to water, as in showering, bathing, and swimming, should not affect the PATCH.
+The optional white, round ADHESIVE COVER should be applied directly over the PATCH, should the PATCH begin to separate from the skin. The ADHESIVE COVER ensures that the PATCH sticks to the skin. The CATAPRES-TTS PATCH must be replaced with a new one on a fresh skin site if the one in use significantly loosens or falls off.
+Skin burns have been reported at the patch site in several patients wearing an aluminized transdermal system during a magnetic resonance imaging scan (MRI). Because the Catapres-TTS® PATCH contains aluminum, it is recommended to remove the system before undergoing an MRI.
+How to Apply the CATAPRES-TTS PATCH
+Apply the square, tan CATAPRES-TTS PATCH once a week, preferably at a convenient time on the same day of the week (i.e., prior to bedtime on Tuesday of week one; prior to bedtime on Tuesday of week two, etc.).
+Select a hairless area such as on the upper, outer arm or upper chest. The area chosen
+should be free of cuts, abrasions, irritation, scars or calluses and should not be shaved before applying the Catapres-TTS® (clonidine) PATCH. Do not place the CATAPRES-TTS PATCH on skin folds or under tight undergarments, since premature loosening may occur.
+Wash hands with soap and water and thoroughly dry them.
+Clean the area chosen with soap and water. Rinse and wipe dry with a clean, dry tissue.
+Select the pouch with the red and orange colors labeled CATAPRES-TTS (clonidine) and open it as illustrated in Figure 3. Remove the square, tan PATCH from the pouch.
+Remove the clear plastic protective backing from the PATCH by gently peeling off one half of the backing at a time as shown in Figure 4. Avoid touching the sticky side of the Catapres-TTS® (clonidine) PATCH.
+Place the CATAPRES-TTS PATCH on the prepared skin site (sticky side down) by applying firm pressure over the PATCH to ensure good contact with the skin, especially around the edges (Figure 5). Discard the clear plastic protective backing and wash your hands with soap and water to remove any drug from your hands.
+After one week, remove the old PATCH and discard it. After choosing a different skin site, repeat instructions 2 through 7 for the application of your next CATAPRES-TTS PATCH.
+What to do if your CATAPRES-TTS PATCH becomes loose while wearing:
+How to Apply the ADHESIVE COVER
+Note:
+The white, round, ADHESIVE COVER
+does not contain any drug
+and should not be used alone. The COVER should be applied directly over the CATAPRES-TTS PATCH
+only
+if the PATCH begins to separate from the skin, thereby ensuring that it sticks to the skin for seven full days.
+1)Wash hands with soap and water and thoroughly dry them.
+2)Using a clean, dry tissue, make sure that the area around the square, tan Catapres TTS® (clonidine) PATCH is clean and dry. Press gently on the CATAPRES-TTS PATCH to ensure that the edges are in good contact with the skin.
+3)Take the white, round, ADHESIVE COVER (Figure 6) from the plain white pouch and remove the paper liner backing from the COVER.
+4)Carefully center the round, white ADHESIVE COVER over the square, tan CATAPRES-TTS PATCH and apply firm pressure, especially around the edges in contact with the skin.
+Instructions for Disposal
+KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN
+During or even after use, a PATCH contains active medication which may be harmful to infants and children if accidentally applied or ingested. After use, fold in half with the sticky sides together. Dispose of carefully out of reach of children.
